description: Dependency updates per ADR-0106. Renovate opens the pull request; the gates decide.
It merges nothing: every update passes the same lint, drift, and test gates a human PR passes, because a bump that skips them is a pin that was never load-bearing.
A dependency held back carries its reason on the package rule that holds it. A pin with no recorded reason is treated as unreviewed.

packageRules.description: A major version is a decision, so it is proposed alone and never joins a group (ADR-0106).
One repository, one dependency graph (ADR-0101): the single go.mod produces one PR, minor and patch together.
Bun packages, likewise one PR for the ecosystem.
One PR for the pinned toolchain file, so a SHA keeps reproducing its own toolchain (ADR-0101).

Container base images and platform chart images: one PR per image, tag and digest together. A digest moving while its tag does not is a rebuild of the same version, which is what base-image patching produces and what a reviewer cannot judge from the diff alone (ADR-0106).
Terraform moves on its own, slower cadence.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The template pin is a dependency like any other: the same weekly mechanism proposes the bump and the same gates judge it (ADR-0106).

customManagers.description: Copier records the template commit a generated project tracks. Renovate bumps it; `copier update` performs the 3-way merge (ADR-0106).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A CVE with a fixed version available is proposed immediately, outside the batch — it is the one class where the weekly slot is too slow (ADR-0106, ADR-0104).
